milestone: Checkmark family: reconciliation and one verified dark-mode contrast fix

baseline.note: MR ref and cached after ref both resolve to fe4adb4f942385912bb3244b570afa475cadf3bd. Snapshot counts reproduced: 194 before, 74 after, 204 rows.

scope.fullInventory: partial; 181 non-checkmark assets are not reconciled in this milestone

introducedByMr.title: Dark-mode disabled checked checkbox check contrast dropped below 3:1
introducedByMr.severity: accessibility regression (measurable; disabled controls are exempt from SC 1.4.11)
introducedByMr.evidence: Chromium screenshots at the actual 21x21 CSS component size; pixel sampling and WCAG contrast calculation.
introducedByMr.notes: The MR correctly aligned the light-mode disabled check with gray-700 (3.16:1 -> 3.78:1) but did not provide a dark-mode pretint, so the same gray-700 is too dark on the dark disabled surface.

resolvedByMr.title: Unused checkmark colour variants removed
resolvedByMr.detail: Seven colour variants plus the unused 12x10 white checkmark have no reference in Drupal core before or after; removal is consistent with consolidation.

resolvedByMr.title: Enabled light-mode checked checkbox uses a white pretint rather than a stale 16x16 file
resolvedByMr.detail: White check remains visible at 21x21; contrast #ffffff on #015efe = 5.21:1.

intentionalChanges.title: Action link checkmark glyph changed from a stroked polyline to the filled canonical check
intentionalChanges.assessment: Intentional icon-family redesign; remains monochrome, non-directional and mask-rendered. Not counted as a regression.

intentionalChanges.title: Checkbox check glyph geometry normalized to the 24x24 canonical check
intentionalChanges.assessment: Geometry and fill construction change; both remain visible at the 21x21 component size. Treated as intentional consolidation.

proposedFixes.title: Add a dark-mode disabled check pretint
proposedFixes.change: Use #adaeb3 (--admin-color-gray-400) only under .dark-mode for checked+disabled checkboxes.
proposedFixes.forcedColorsResult: unchanged: native checkbox appearance; screenshots identical to MR head

unresolvedInvestigations: The live Drupal 12 test applied only the MR checkmark files/CSS to the lab baseline theme; the complete MR theme was not installed.
Windows High Contrast native verification remains outstanding; forced-colours results are Chromium emulation.
The other 181 original assets are not reconciled in this milestone.
Whole-core absence of a literal/dynamic reference is evidence, not proof, that third-party code or user configuration never used a removed colour variant.

pixelDiff.changedRegion: only the disabled checked checkbox row

renderingEvidence.rtl: Not applicable to the non-directional check glyph; toggle RTL transform rules unchanged.
renderingEvidence.reducedMotion: No animation in the affected check assets; toggle transition rules unchanged.

warnings: Explicit paint values: check light, dark and forced-colours contexts

validation.geometryCheck: New pretint uses the exact path data of check.svg; only fill changes.
validation.validatorCoverage: Partial structural checks only (XML, namespace, viewBox, IDs, path-character heuristic); not full SVG conformance.
validation.referenceSearchNote: Exact-path searches for all removed checkmark file paths returned no matches anywhere in core at the after revision. The proposed theme has 81 resolved SVG references and 0 missing.

limitations: The live Drupal test applied only the checkmark files/CSS to the lab baseline theme, not the complete MR theme. Full-theme integration remains to be verified.
The lab site is Drupal 12-dev d29add7e; the MR head is fe4adb4. The check component CSS/assets match the MR head, but the rest of the MR theme was not live-tested.
Chromium forced-colours emulation is not native Windows High Contrast.
Disabled controls are exempt from WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11; the finding is a measurable state-visibility regression, not a claim of a WCAG failure.
No full SVG conformance or WCAG conformance claimed.
Only the checkmark family is reconciled.

liveDrupalIntegration.method: The MR-head checkmark assets and CSS were applied surgically to the lab baseline default_admin theme (not the full MR theme), caches rebuilt, measured, then the proposed fix added and measured again. The backed-up baseline theme was restored exactly afterwards (diff clean).
liveDrupalIntegration.forcedColors: Native checkbox appearance retained; checked state visible in forced light and forced dark screenshots.
liveDrupalIntegration.restored: Baseline theme restored; diff against backup is empty; DDEV site is running.
